20062.long_desc:
The coinop operated timer control panel is designed exclusively for the Game Wizard Xtreme. It allows coin operation for arcade games, consoles, PC and more. Highly suitable for internet cafes and rentals where customers can add their own game accounts to the machine and rent the game cabinet from you on time.

Highly configurable, the Coin Operated Timer Board Control Panel offers owners to customise settings including welcome screen, set multiple timer options including bonus time, setting the machine on coin or free play, and much more.

The Top Control Panel Coin Operated Timer Panel also has LED display with LED multicolour lighting with colour matching for time remaining.

Key features of the timer PCB include;

- Setup functions (price per play, including bonus times)
- Bookkeeping function
- Freeplay on/off
- customised messaging
- customised LED lighting display

The Arcooda Game Wizard Xtreme series offers a modular design allowing you to change the top control panel as your gaming and store operations change.

This is an exclusive product for Game Wizard Xtreme 1.0, 2.0 and 3.0 machine owners.
